title: simonlin1212/global-stock-data
claim: A single skill file giving AI coding assistants zero-auth US market data from official sources: CBOE options with full Greeks + 0DTE flow, FINRA short volume, SEC EDGAR stream, free screener — 30+ endpoints, each labeled with its compliance tier.
why_good: Bets on a genuinely new distribution channel — market data consumed by coding agents, not humans — and the verbatim compliance-tier labeling ('official ≠ free to use') is the credibility detail incumbents skip. 1.4k★/211 forks in 2 months.
value: Classic data-business funnel with an agent-native twist: free official-source tier up top, then paid real-time/licensed feeds, hosted endpoints with SLAs, and per-agent metering as AI assistants become the main consumers of market data.
risk: It aggregates endpoints it doesn't own — any source can change terms or rate-limit overnight; and if agent-native distribution proves out, Polygon or Databento can ship an official 'AI skill' wrapper in a week.

zh.claim: 一个单一的技能文件，提供来自官方来源的零认证美国市场数据给AI编码助手：CBOE期权的完整希腊字母 + 0DTE流量，FINRA短期交易量，SEC EDGAR流，免费的筛选器——30多个端点，每个端点都有合规等级标记。
zh.why_good: 押注于一个真正新的分发渠道——由编码代理消费的市场数据，而非人类——逐字的合规等级标记（'官方 ≠ 免费使用'）是现有企业所忽视的可信度细节。2个月内获得1.4k★/211个分支。
zh.value: 经典的数据业务漏斗，带有代理原生的特点：顶部是免费的官方来源等级，然后是付费的实时/许可数据流，托管的端点带有服务水平协议（SLA），以及随着AI助手成为市场数据的主要消费者而进行的按代理计费。
zh.risk: 它聚合了自己并不拥有的端点——任何来源都可以在一夜之间更改条款或限制速率；如果代理原生分发证明有效，Polygon或Databento可以在一周内推出官方的'AI技能'封装。
